findings.issue: 何時 in this sentence means 'what time (o'clock)' — the record's own en/pt/lit say 'What time is dinner? / A que horas'. The correct reading is なんじ; kana transcribes it as いつ ('when'), a wrong reading in context.
findings.current: ゆうしょくわいつでしょう。
findings.suggested: ゆうしょくわなんじでしょう。

findings.issue: Reading of 何時 must be なんじ in this context ('what time is dinner', matching en 'what time' / pt 'que horas'); いつ would mean 'when' and contradicts the sentence's own translations.
Romaji propagates the wrong reading いつ for 何時; should reflect なんじ (nanji).

Topic particle は was not converted to phonetic わ (corpus convention, applied in all sibling items, e.g. かれわ in 79120). Sentence is pronounced ゆうしょくわいりません; as written the string reads like the verb 入り (hairi), hiding the particle.
findings.current: ゆうしょくはいりません。
findings.suggested: ゆうしょくわいりません。

findings.issue: Romaji encodes the topic particle as 'ha', producing 'hairimasen' which reads as 入りません ('does not enter') instead of は + 要りません. Pronunciation is 'yuushoku wa irimasen'.

Token surface はいり wrongly merges the topic particle は with the verb stem いり (要る), so the displayed 'verb' looks like 入り (hairu). The gloss/note themselves say the verb is いり+ません (要る). Should be two tokens: particle は (r: わ) + stem いり.
findings.suggested: split: は (r: わ, tópico) + いり (r: いり, raiz de 要る)

findings.issue: pt gloss of いい was copied from a different sentence about よくない ('bem, forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom'), which does not occur here. In this sentence いい simply modifies ところ ('um bom lugar'); en gloss correctly says 'good'.
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)

findings.issue: Sub-tokens 出 and かけ (constituents of 出かけ) are misplaced at the start of the token array, before 夕食に, breaking sentence surface order; in the parallel pattern (79159: 郵便+局+郵便局) sub-tokens sit directly adjacent to their merged token.
findings.current: 出 / かけ listed as tokens 0–1, before 夕食
findings.suggested: Move the 出 and かけ sub-tokens to immediately precede the merged 出かけ token
